title: The Electric Truck Lead Just Flipped Twice
source: Ford F-150 Lightning US annual deliveries: 2022 approx. 15,617 (first partial year); 2023 approx. 24,165; 2024 33,510; 2025 approx. 27,300 (CarBuzz/Electrek reporting). Tesla Cybertruck deliveries: 2022 0 (not yet launched); 2023 approx. 3,900 (limited late-2023 ramp after Nov 2023 launch, industry-tracker estimate); 2024 39,442 (surpassed Lightning for the first time in Q2 2024); 2025 approx. 21,500 global (InsideEVs/Forbes/Electrek reporting on the sales reversal). Ford ended F-150 Lightning production in Dec 2025/Jan 2026 (Electrek); Cybertruck Q1 2026 fell to 3,519 units, its worst quarter yet.
